slots.name: meeting date
slots.sentence: Sharif alleged at a televised news conference on Thursday that members of several militant groups had met in Kandahar on Aug. 26.

slots.name: attendees
slots.sentence: Sharif said those represented included the outlawed Baloch Liberation Army, or BLA, an ethnic separatist group fighting for an independent Balochistan; al-Qaida in the Indian Subcontinent, or AQIS, the global militant network’s South Asian affiliate; and the Hafiz Gul Bahadur group, an independent Pakistani Islamist militant network rooted in North Waziristan.

events.label: Kandahar governor denial of militant meeting claim

slots.name: confirmation status
slots.sentence: The office of the governor, Mohammad Shirin Akhund, dismissed the claim made on Thursday by Pakistani army spokesman Lt. Gen. Ahmad Sharif as “propaganda.”
